Growth Factor Concentrate
The PRP-GFC Treatment
PRP-GFC (Growth Factor Concentrate) is ISAAC Luxe's autologous, acellular regenerative therapy — a dual-purpose treatment that uses your own blood to restore fuller, healthier hair and revive your skin's natural radiance.

The treatment processes a small blood sample into a concentrated serum of pure bioactive growth factors using Viyata, India's first international autologous, acellular, complete GFC kit, delivered via gamma-sterile, single-use tubes with minimal to no pain or inflammation. The kit is clinically used by more than 2,000 doctors and exported to the UK, Kenya, Sri Lanka, Malaysia, Mauritius, and the GCC, manufactured in a CDSCO-approved facility and certified to ISO 9001:2015, IAF, and CE standards.

The 4-Step Process

1. Harvest

Collection of 16ml of blood in two gamma-sterile tubes.

2. Activate

Tubes are inverted 3–4 times and left still for 30 minutes, activating platelets and releasing growth factors.

3. Separate

Growth factors are isolated via centrifugation at 3,500 rpm for 10 minutes.

4. Inject

The concentrated GFC serum is ready for precise injection into the treatment area.

What It Treats
Hair Thinning & Hair Fall Melasma Wrinkles & Fine Lines Acne Scars Skin Tightening Low Hair Density

The Visionary Behind ISAAC Luxe
Dr. Geetika Mittal Gupta
Founder and Medical Director of ISAAC Luxe / Aesthetic Physician, and award-winning cosmetologist — Dr. Geetika Mittal Gupta is one of India's most sought-after skin experts.

With over 15 years of experience in aesthetics, Dr. Geetika has built a reputation for personalised care and delivering results with minimal risk. Her clientele includes celebrities, influencers, and discerning individuals who trust her expertise.

She is a pioneer in introducing globally advanced treatments to India — from AI-integrated diagnostics and cutting-edge IV therapy to advanced body sculpting technology — setting new benchmarks in luxury dermatology.

Celebrity Trusted

Preferred aesthetic destination for Bollywood celebrities, fashion icons, social media influencers, and high-profile personalities across India's entertainment and fashion industry.

Unique AI-driven approach to long-term beauty built on three pillars: Treatment, Prevention, and Maintenance — ensuring lasting results and healthier skin over time.
